profile.headline: Software Engineer II @ Disney | Microsoft | CSE @ University of Washington
profile.summary: Hi everyone. I'm Jessica, a software engineer. I have a passion in full-stack/back-end development and currently working on some cool projects at Disney that utilize AI to help teams at work become even more efficient! I hope to transform technology and always retaining the human touch in them to assist our daily lives.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
AI & Observability Team, Sept 2026 - present:
Insights & AI value arises from assisting teams move faster by turning fragmented operational signals into usable decision support aiming to enhance quality and stability of their own solutions by:
- Earlier detection of quality or service issues using machine learning and anomaly detection
Faster incident response through AI-generated context, service ownership hints, dependency analysis, and RCA drafting
- Better operational consistency through standardized reporting, explainability, and shared workflows
- Lower integration burden by building a reusable platform, APIs, and dashboards rather than one-off solutions


Streaming Backend Team, June 2024 - Sept 2026:
Supporting 1M+ concurrent daily user data from Disney+ & Hulu at Disney Streaming

- Spearheaded initiative to optimize clients' data through efficient data publishing that reduced costs by 30% and engaged 3 teams through cross-org collaboration.
- Developed an internal MCP server that integrates with Anthropic Claude to optimize engineers' workflow, including improvements to oncall rotation, automated tasks, and investigative runbooks.
- Orchestrated daily deployments of a unified platform for capturing, storing, and enriching 1M+ concurrent Disney+ & Hulu users' activities. This helps with analyzing the data for further development, targeted advertisements, and improving app user experiences.
positions.insights: Skills: Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Model Context Protocol (MCP) · Anthropic Claude · Cursor AI · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Java · Kubernetes · Terraform · Docker Products · Spinnaker · Maven · Apache Flink · Datadog · Jira · Spring Boot · Amazon Kinesis · Gatling Enterprise · Apache Kafka

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Member of the Engineering Systems team in Azure Edge + Platform

- Worked on deprecation efforts for a 20-year on-prem Windows legacy database system, implemented internal Database REST API controller library as replacement
- Using service oriented architecture in Azure to scale microservice horizontally, improved efficiency, scalability, and stability of data platform
- Worked around technical requirements and architectural design to build/maintain the team’s service using Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines
- Optimized team’s Cosmos NoSQL indexing/partitioning strategies, cutting query times and improving service database performance
- Managed critical incidents in 24/7 on-call rotation, reducing response times and ensuring service operational excellence
positions.insights: Skills: C# · NoSQL · Java · Representational State Transfer (REST) · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Azure Cosmos DB · Kusto Query Language (KQL) · Powershell · GitHub · GraphQL · .NET Framework · DevOps · Azure DevOps Server · SQL · Microsoft Azure · Azure Cloud · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Cursor AI · Anthropic Claude · Model Context Protocol (MCP)

positions.title: Computer Science Tutor
positions.description:
- Worked collaboratively in a team of 10 to assist Computer Science students with homework assignments, exam review, and projects that are associated with Computer Science classes that improved students’ grades.
- Assisted students in 30-minute 1:1 sessions in data structures and object-oriented programming concept to produce innovative solutions.
- Modeled learning strategies and study habits like time-management and prioritization to help students perform better in academics.
positions.insights: Skills: Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Cursor AI · Model Context Protocol (MCP) · Anthropic Claude

positions.title: Fellow
positions.description:
- Member and Fellow of Rewriting the Code, a 7000+ person community that empowers women in STEM through mentorship, networking, and industry experience.
- Attend quarterly resume critiques and mock interviews in a team of 5 for assistance and networking opportunities in professional workplaces
- Participate in monthly guest speakers’ sessions and weekly engineering events to gain deeper insights into the professional STEM industry.
- Enriched career opportunities from RTC-hosted career fairs like the "Rewrite Your Future" Career Summit.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Anthropic Claude · Cursor AI

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Worked on Azure Edge & Platform Time Travel Debugging:

-Contributed to WinDbg Time Travel Debugging Automated Replay Feature, saving manual debugging time and management overhead 
-Programmed code execution recording and replaying capabilities; maintained/enhanced automated test cases and deployment procedures
-Use real time data insights from customers to monitor service capability & auto scale/shard data to improve latency and availability
-Contributed to front-end engineering with Docker containers, client UI, and Excel graph modeling for Time Travel Debug service effectiveness
positions.insights: Skills: C# · docker · Java · Azure Cosmos DB · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · ASP.NET MVC · Kubernetes · Lucene · SQL · HTML · Azure Cloud · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Anthropic Claude · Cursor AI · Model Context Protocol (MCP)

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Worked in the Office of the CTO (Chief Tech Officer) on the Supplier Relationship Management team:

-Developed in-house interactive web app for the Supplier Management Team through PowerApps platform, using HTML/CSS design
-Used Business/Stakeholder/Technical requirements to assist in analyzing the existing solutions to address the needs of teams
-Boosted workflow automation by 50% through Azure Cloud Services utilization for efficient internal service information retrieval
-Managed priorities, deadlines, and deliverables in an Agile environment, ensuring consistent weekly development cycles
-Analyzed system performance impacting the complete product for non-functional requirements like reliability, operability, performance efficiency and security
positions.insights: Skills: Java · TypeScript · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · HTML · Microsoft Azure · Azure Cloud · Microsoft Power Apps

positions.title: Academic Tutor
positions.description:
- Tutored 20-person class sessions for K-12 students in reading and mathematics, problem-solving strategies, and comprehension to help improve cognitive skills in students.
- Graded students’ homework, in-class assignments, and examinations; managed a company-wide database with students’ data to increase workplace productivity and show trends in students’ academic improvement once a month using statistics.

positions.title: SWEHacks Marketing/Advertising Committee Member
positions.description:
- Worked on the Marketing Committee for SWEHacks Hackathon (200+ attendees event) for the Society of Women in Engineering at UW.
- Attended quarterly resume critiques and mock interviews in a team of 5 for assistance and networking opportunities in professional workplaces.
- Participated in monthly guest speakers’ sessions and weekly engineering events to gain deeper insights into the professional STEM industry.
- Worked to build a support network of 1000+ undergraduate women studying STEM at the UW.

volunteerExperiences.description:
- Volunteered once a week as part of Boeing's Employee Volunteering program in a team of 50
- Participated in the packaging of large food amounts into smaller bags for distribution around the NorthWest area for the homeless population of 2000+
- Assisted in the cleaning of volunteering area such as mopping, wiping, and restocking of food items after every shift

- Volunteered once a week as part of McKnight Middle School's Afterschool program in a team of 10
- Supervised and assisted 30-50 middle school students in creative projects like arts, crafts, games, and outdoor sports
- Assisted in the cleaning of volunteering area such as mopping, wiping, and putting away tables/chairs after every shift

projects.title: Points & Travel Suite
projects.description:
Claude Code-powered travel advisor portal | Apr 2026
• Built a credit-card-points travel advisor with Claude Code and Supabase, including a flight seat-exchange
marketplace.
• Integrated the Anthropic API to generate hotel and business-class award redemption recommendations from users' loyalty-program inputs.

projects.title: Prompt Wizard | Microsoft Hackathon 2023
projects.description:
Event Site: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/events/hack-together-powerplatform-ai/

- In a group of 5, I was the developer for our website. Our mission track was "to integrate AI in an innovative way".
- Utilized OpenAI LLM API to develop an interactive prompting tool to help users recap and generate next steps after a meeting
- Produced hosted website through Azure Power Apps, controlling data flow through Power Automate and front-end through HTML/CSS
